The five bands are always present in fixed order even on an empty world, because a missing band and an empty band must not be confused; the intervals are half-open with the lower bound included so a boundary value lands in the larger band (2.0 small, 10.0 medium, 25.0 large, 50.0 sweep) and a zero step is impossible because the write side already refuses a same-price revision. Step arithmetic is the volatility law exactly, from two stored prices and never a wall clock. Count conservation holds per band and against api_price_volatility on the same scope; step_share sums to 1.0 and an empty band reports None instead of a fabricated 0.0; within-band and pooled absolute aggregates are pinned; the modal band breaks ties toward the smaller magnitude. Row authority is the rating side, so one call answers both halves - what was answered and how slowly, and what is still owed - in a pinned total order (answered by descending latency then rating_id, pending after them by rated_utc then rating_id). Stars read through the effective-stars seam and reply text through the effective-reply seam, so a revised reply moves the text while the historical latency stays frozen; the effective title comes from the metadata seam. Coverage, average, median parity, fastest, slowest, latest reply stamp and oldest outstanding stamp all answer None where nothing was answered.
